case_information.customer_feedback_summary: Guests frequently praised the hotel's central location; several also noted good air conditioning. Multiple reviews reported noise and poor soundproofing. Feedback on staff varied: some found staff friendly while others reported rudeness, absence, and a room/refund dispute. Cleanliness and facilities were mixed—some praised clean bathrooms, while others mentioned dirty shared showers, broken appliances, aging or small/stuffy rooms, and unclear late‑check‑in charges.

review_summary_metadata.summary_method: Neutral LLM summary of the frozen recent review sample; no additional reviews retrieved.

priorities.recommendation: Verify cleanliness and availability of supplies in all shared bathrooms.

priorities.area: Staff communication, booking accuracy and late check-in/fees transparency
priorities.recommendation: Review front-desk procedures and written communications concerning reservations, refunds, and late-check-in fees.
Schedule an inspection of windows and doors to determine if repairs or replacement are needed.
Ensure 24/7 or extended front-desk/onsite staff coverage or a reliable on-call system.
Standardize written procedures for booking discrepancies and late check-in fees.
Conduct an urgent inventory and functional check of all in-room and communal appliances.
